connector.name: NoteMCP
connector.registryDescription: Shared Markdown notes for MCP-compatible AI tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at note-mcp.vercel.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jithinlalk25 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
